name: HDDA Hybrid
definition: A hybrid traversal algorithm that uses HDDA to skip empty tiles (dim >= leafdim) and DDA to traverse occupied tiles voxel-by-voxel.
summary: HDDA Hybrid is a ray traversal algorithm for sparse VDB grids that combines hierarchical skipping with fine-grained voxel-by-voxel traversal to optimize performance in empty space while maintaining accuracy in dense regions.
